g.text: Coach and bogies — revised connections and stops
CI3-A01 · CI3-R0 · Current assembled CAD · Nominal millimetres
Four stepped crossmember end connections; central bogie chord lowered 12 mm.
Reinforced bump-stop load paths; rubber contact 25 mm / positive metal limit 32 mm.
Front / rear pivot centres 1143 and 6629.4 mm; floor 812.8 mm above rail, unchanged.
Open Crossmember connection or Bump stops & restraint in the shared Rotate 3D viewer.
Dimensioned connections: CI3-J01. Stops: CI3-S01. Spring seats: CI3-R01. Keeper: CI3-K01. Engineering separate.
